items.name: Remaining performance obligations
items.claim: Genius Sports Limited's revenue allocated to remaining performance obligations was $634.7 million as of June 30, 2026. The Company expects to recognize approximately 55% in revenue within one year, and the remainder within the next 13 to 78 months.
